d: On November 26, The Indian Express hosted the third edition of 26/11 Stories of Strength, an initiative to honour survivors and their families and to recount their stories of resilience in the face of grief and loss. Kaushiki Chakraborty took the stage at the gateway of India to sing song written by Rabindranath Tagore. She was accompanied by Rakesh Chaurasia on the flute and Merlin D’Souza on piano.
